reasoning.description: Think step by step: walk the plan section by section (Problem Statement, Behavioral contrast, Technical Constraints, the dependency table, and each task's Contract block) before naming any flaw. Write that reasoning here — it is not graded directly, but a leading reasoning field measurably improves the quality of constrained JSON output.

id.description: A short stable slug for the flaw, e.g. 'unfalsifiable-criterion'.

where.description: The section or task heading the flaw lives in.

why.description: One sentence naming exactly what is wrong, citing the conflicting text by section/task name.

flaws.description: Every genuine design flaw you found in the plan. Do not include stylistic nits, missing-but-optional sections, or anything that is merely unusual-looking but turns out to be correct once checked against the rest of the document.

confidence.description: 0-100: how confident you are that the flaws list is complete and free of false positives.
